build_V2VNet_backbone: build a V2VNet 3D voxel-to-voxel backbone model with configurable input and output channels
create_Basic3DBlock: create a Basic3DBlock 3D convolutional block with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size
create_Res3DBlock: create a Res3DBlock residual 3D convolutional block with skip connection for channel mismatch
create_EncoderDecorder: create an EncoderDecorder block with encoder, decoder, and skip connections for 3D feature processing
review_V2VNet_forward: review the V2VNet forward pass that chains front_layers, encoder_decoder, and output_layer
